issue.title: [YSQL] [DocDB] Upgrade OpenSSL to 3.0.8 from 1.1.1

labels.name: kind/enhancement
labels.description: This is an enhancement of an existing feature

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-5816](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-5816)
### Description

Upgrade the OpenSSL version from 1.1.1 to 3.0.8, as 1.1.1 version support is ending.

Advantages of upgrading to OpenSSL 3.0.8:
* The failure logs will give the failure reason as well (https://postgrespro.com/list/thread-id/2585389)
* Version 1.1.1 will be supported until 2023-09-11
* 3.0+ also has a new trace API to help with debugging. 

[OpenSSL migration guide](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man3.0/man7/migration_guide.html)

- Import required upstream PG commits
  - [x] #19732
  - [x] #19733
  - [x] #19734
- [x] #19737  - Imported PG commits depend on it
- [x] #19727 - Triggered when there are no available protocols - relevant with 3.0.8 version.
- [x] #19736

### Warning: Please confirm that this issue does not contain any sensitive information

- [X] I confirm this issue does not contain any sensitive information.
